auto_merge.commit_message:
Fixes #7073.

Make `sys.getsizeof()` include the shape/stride allocation and the data
buffer allocated by `cython.view.array`. Buffers supplied by callers are
excluded, including when a custom deallocation callback is present,
because their ownership and allocation size are not known.

Tests: existing array tests and new ownership/size tests with C and C++
backends on x86-64 and aarch64 (42 passed on each); shared utility mode
on x86-64 (14 passed).

AI assistance: OpenAI Codex assisted with the implementation and tests.

---------

Co-authored-by: scoder <stefan_ml@behnel.de>

comment_data.body:
In the case of test failures, the output of this is an unhelpful `False`. The following would improve it:
```suggestion
    size_difference = sys.getsizeof(large) - sys.getsizeof(small)
    assert size_difference == 1023 * sizeof(int), size_difference / sizeof(int)
```
The same applies to all other tests.
comment_data.diff_hunk:
@@ -0,0 +1,65 @@
+# mode: run
+
+import sys
+from cython.view cimport array
+from libc.stdlib cimport malloc, free
+
+def allocated_data_size():
+    """
+    >>> allocated_data_size()
+    True
+    """
+    cdef array small = array((1,), sizeof(int), 'i')
+    cdef array large = array((1024,), sizeof(int), 'i')
+    return sys.getsizeof(large) - sys.getsizeof(small) == 1023 * sizeof(int)

comment_data.body:
`self._shape` should never be `NULL` when we get here.
```suggestion
        size += 2 * self.ndim * sizeof(Py_ssize_t)
```
comment_data.diff_hunk:
@@ -245,6 +245,14 @@ cdef class array:
     def __len__(self):
         return self._shape[0]
 
+    def __sizeof__(self):
+        size = object.__sizeof__(self)
+        if self._shape is not NULL:
+            size += 2 * self.ndim * sizeof(Py_ssize_t)

comment_data.body:
Thanks, now done for all the other tests too (1d179f7). Since the functions no longer return anything, the doctests also stop expecting `True`. The first test still expected it after the suggestion commit, so it would have failed.

Locally (CPython 3.13, macOS arm64) the test passes. With the `__sizeof__` change reverted, the three tests that depend on it fail with `AssertionError: 0.0`.

Show the size difference when a test fails instead of a bare False. The doctests now expect no output, since the functions no longer return a value.
